class.name: JRPGArmorData
class.brief_description: An armor: equipment for the slots after the weapon slot.
class.description: Database entry for armor. It goes into the equipment slot given by [member equip_type_id] and adds its parameter changes and traits while equipped.

members.member: ID of the armor type in [member JRPGTypesData.armor_types]. Actors can equip it only if a trait allows that type.
ID of the equipment slot the armor goes into, from [member JRPGTypesData.equip_types]. Slot 1 is the weapon slot, so armors normally use slot 2 or higher.
